title: Horace Paine House, Walker & Illinois Streets, Grand Detour, Ogle County, IL
notes: Significance: The builder of this fine little Greek house was one of the owners of the first cold steel plow factory, along with John Deere, pioneer developer of agricultural implements. The house is unusual for its interesting grilled frieze windows and delicately detailed doorway.
Unprocessed Field note material exists for this structure: FN-159
